channel.description: Latest stories from Sankaku Complex through AniNews Hub.

item.title: Fuji TV Plans to Introduce Generative AI Across All Its Live-Action Dramas by 2027
item.description: Japanese broadcasting giant Fuji TV has announced plans to introduce generative artificial intelligence into the production of all its live-action television dramas by October 2027, following experiments that reportedly reduced workloads by as much as 80% in certain production tasks.

item.title: Japanese User Lambasted for Trying to Look up Skirt in Ocarina of Time Remake
item.description: The internet’s usual suspects are once again upset at someone doing something they don’t like, as a Japanese Twitter user who posted a video of himself attempting to look up the skirt of a female character in Ocarina of Time remake earned a great deal of criticism.

item.title: Hagure Idol Jigoku Hen Anime Officially Announced
item.description: The controversial action manga Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight!, known in Japan as Hagure Idol Jigoku-hen, is officially receiving a television anime adaptation scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

item.title: Pixiv Loses Wise Payouts After Account Suspension
item.description: Japanese illustration platform Pixiv has announced that Wise will no longer be available for creator payouts starting in November 2026, leaving some international artists unable to withdraw their earnings and forcing others to abandon their subscriptions.

item.title: Blue Archive English Localization Removes “Make Gehenna Great Again” Reference
item.description: The English localization of Blue Archive has changed the title of an upcoming story chapter from “Make Gehenna Great Again!” to “Glory to Gehenna!”, removing an apparent reference to US President Donald Trump’s famous political slogan that remains intact in the Japanese and Korean versions.

item.title: Hideo Kojima Says AI Takes the Fun Out of Creating Games
item.description: Metal Gear Solid and Death Stranding creator Hideo Kojima has expressed concerns about the increasing use of artificial intelligence in creative industries, arguing that while AI makes development more efficient, it threatens to eliminate the very process that makes creating something enjoyable.

item.title: Survey Claims Only 6.7% of Japanese People Have Stopped Reading Manga
item.description: Despite growing concerns that Japanese audiences are abandoning manga, a new nationwide survey suggests that relatively few people have stopped reading the medium altogether over the past five years.

item.title: Kodansha Considers Canceling Mii-chan Anime Following Disability Group Complaints
item.description: Japanese publisher Kodansha is reconsidering its upcoming anime adaptation of Mii-chan and Miss Yamada, potentially canceling the project following criticism from disability advocacy organizations over its portrayal of people with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

item.title: Tokyo Births Rise 4.7% as Japan Records First Increase in 11 Years
item.description: Tokyo has recorded a surprising 4.7% increase in births during the first half of 2026, significantly outperforming the rest of Japan and helping the country achieve its first nationwide increase in births in 11 years – though, many are undoubtedly going to wonder if the births were actual Japanes…

item.title: Duolingo Orders Artist to Delete Suggestive Fan Art of Goth Mascot Lily
item.description: Language-learning company Duolingo has reportedly demanded the removal of suggestive fan art featuring Lily, its purple-haired goth mascot, prompting an online backlash after the artist announced that the company’s legal team had contacted them.

item.title: Goddess of Victory: NIKKE PC Launcher Compromised
item.description: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE has reportedly been compromised in a supply-chain cyberattack, potentially exposing players’ passwords, authentication credentials, and other sensitive information to hackers.

item.title: Nexus Mods Removes Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Character Mod
item.description: Video game modding platform Nexus Mods has once again ousted another innocent mod, this time removing a Cyberpunk 2077 modification featuring Talia Yang from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, and prompting accusations that the website is censoring an adult character because of her youthful appearance.

item.title: Google to Disable Search for Schools That Refuse AI Tools

item.title: Itch.io Deletes Terabytes of “AI Slop” & Adds Filter to Block AI Games
item.description: Independent gaming platform itch.io has deleted several terabytes of what it describes as “AI slop” from its storefront, while introducing new filtering options that allow customers to exclude games and other content created using generative artificial intelligence.

item.title: Transformers Toy Giant Takara Tomy Launches Indie Game Publisher
item.description: Japanese toy manufacturer Takara Tomy, best known for popular franchises such as Transformers, Beyblade, and Tomica, has announced its entry into the independent video game publishing market, unveiling a new label called ENJOYN GAMES alongside three upcoming titles.

item.description: Valve has introduced stricter requirements for developers submitting games to Steam after acknowledging that a substantial increase in new releases has overwhelmed its review process, causing approval delays of up to 12 business days and forcing some independent developers to postpone their launc…

item.title: Square Enix Wanted Cheap Final Fantasy Port, Producer Rejected Gacha
item.description: Final Fantasy Resonance producer Keisuke Nakashima has revealed that Square Enix executives initially wanted to release a cheaper, straightforward port of the mobile RPG Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, but he pushed for a more ambitious console adaptation without gacha mechanics or microtransactions.
